tasks.subject: Task 1: still_remove extraction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One engine-level copy of the still-image detect-to-remove policy + the write tail (`src/core/still_remove.{hpp,cpp}`), callable by CLI, batch, and GUI, with structured outcomes and zero CliOptions dependency.

**Files:**
- Create: src/core/still_remove.hpp, src/core/still_remove.cpp
- Modify: src/cli/cli_app.cpp (:194-309 policy, :420-442 write tail, :52-109 helpers deleted), src/cli/cli_app.hpp (delete 4 helper decls), src/cli/batch_processor.cpp, CMakeLists.txt (SOURCES), tests/CMakeLists.txt (LIB_SOURCES)
- Test: tests/unit/still_remove_test.cpp

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- remove_still(WatermarkEngine&, cv::Mat&, const StillRemoveOptions&) -> StillRemoveOutcome {Removed,NoWatermark,Failed; forced/bbox/score/geometry_source/variant/error}; never throws
- write_still_output(path, image, keep_provenance): JPEG 100 / PNG 6 / WebP 101 + provenance strip; CLI + batch call it; no direct cv::imwrite left in their write paths
- parse_rect + resolve_inpaint_config take StillRemoveOptions; still_remove.* includes no cli/*.hpp, no CLI11
- wmr_tests links; [still-remove] tests pass
- Manual regression battery byte-identical (md5) vs pre-extraction binary on test1/test2/test4/test3, 864x1231 fixture, poster-artnight + paintings (noWM: no output, rc 0), gemini38 corpus (7/8 removed)
- CLI exit codes unchanged (no-watermark single-image rc 0 no file; malformed --rect rc 1)

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[still-remove]"; battery per plan Task 1 Step 8 (git-stash old-binary md5 protocol).

tasks.subject: Task 3: GUI server + security + browser
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/security.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/http_server.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/browser.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/image_sniff.{hpp,cpp}
- Test: tests/unit/gui_security_test.cpp, tests/unit/gui_sniff_test.cpp

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- generate_token(): 32 lowercase hex (platform CSPRNG); host_allowed accepts exactly 127.0.0.1:P / localhost:P / [::1]:P (case-insensitive, one trailing dot) and rejects absent/empty/foreign
- Pre-routing: empty 404 off-token paths; 403 Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site; nosniff on everything; no CORS header ever
- GuiServer: bind_to_any_port (ephemeral default), banner AFTER bind, browser after listen, bind failure on pinned port prints 'port N in use...' + rc 1
- sniff_image: PNG/JPEG/WebP magic + dimensions; too_large at W*H>120MP or side>16384; HEIC/PDF/0-byte unsupported/empty
- open_browser: BROWSER env, open/xdg-open (DISPLAY/WAYLAND gated)/ShellExecuteW/WSL wslview; failure non-fatal

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui]"

tasks.subject: Task 4: job manager + run dirs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Per-run cache dirs (0700, pid sidecar, dead-pid cleanup), job/file state machines per the spec tables, one serialized worker running remove_still with exception isolation.

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/run_dir.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/jobs.{hpp,cpp}
- Test: tests/unit/gui_jobs_test.cpp

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- create_run_dir/cleanup_dead_runs/remove_run_dir per spec (never wipe shared root; no instance lock)
- Job states queued|running|done|failed|cancelled; file outcomes pending|removed|no-watermark|failed|not-run; done regardless of per-file failures; failed only job-level
- Cancel table exact: queued immediate; running between-files w/ retention; terminal rejected; unknown 404; first-terminal-wins under mutex
- One worker; <=8 pending (too_many_pending); injectable processor for tests
- Per-file try/catch -> failed + continue; loop escape -> job failed, worker survives
- IMREAD_COLOR decode; per-file rect bounds check; write_still_output to out/<i>_clean.<ext>; one reused WatermarkEngine

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui-jobs]"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gui/run_dir.hpp", "src/gui/run_dir.cpp", "src/gui/jobs.hpp", "src/gui/jobs.cpp", "tests/unit/gui_jobs_test.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./build/tests/wmr_tests \"[gui-jobs]\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cancel transition table exact", "per-file isolation + worker survival", "per-run dirs, dead-pid cleanup only"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

- Routes: GET / (3 assets, CSP on HTML), /api/version (features + presets from kStillPresetNames), GET /api/jobs (newest first), POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}, POST .../cancel, GET .../files/{i}/image?kind=

tasks.subject: Task 6: entry points + shutdown
tasks.description:
**Goal:** wmr gui subcommand + no-args-always-GUI (WMR_NO_GUI/CI gates) + graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown + console banner; both GUI paths return before the update-check chokepoint.

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/launch.{hpp,cpp}
- Modify: src/cli/cli_app.cpp (no-args :765-769, subcommand table, dispatch)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- wmr gui [--gui-port N] [--no-browser]; early returns skip the update-check tail (no fetch at shutdown)
- No-args always GUI unless WMR_NO_GUI=1 or CI (those print today's header+help, exit 0, byte-identical); --help/--version/parse errors unchanged; OFF build: no-args help, wmr gui GUI-free message + exit 2
- Shutdown: stop accepting, cancel all, join worker <=5 s, remove run dir, exit 0; second Ctrl-C immediate exit
- Banner: version, tokenized URL, Ctrl-C hint, wmr --help note

**Verify (manual matrix):** wmr; wmr | cat; WMR_NO_GUI=1 wmr | head -3; CI=1 wmr | head -3; wmr --help; wmr gui --no-browser + Ctrl-C (exit 0 within 5 s); OFF build wmr gui; echo $? -> 2.

tasks.subject: Task 7: embedded web frontend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The single-page UI (drop/batch, Advanced disclosure, results rows without thumbnails, before/after + bbox overlay, download, offline banner), embedded as three byte arrays with a drift guard.

**Files:**
- Create: assets/gui/{index.html,app.js,style.css}, scripts/embed_gui_assets.py (dev-only), assets/embedded_gui_assets.hpp (generated, committed), src/gui/embedded_ui.{hpp,cpp}
- Test: tests/unit/gui_assets_test.cpp (drift guard)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Three sources served at /<token>/, /app.js, /style.css; CSP header on HTML; no inline script/style; zero external requests; textContent only
- Drop + Browse, multi-file; client-side split above caps (100 files / 1 GiB per job); rows = filename + badge + actions (removed / no watermark found / failed / queued / not-run; 'removed (forced)'); Compare dialog with bbox overlay + slider; Download; Cancel
- Advanced: legacy, force, preset dropdown (from /api/version), rect fields, denoise (ai when available), keep-provenance; rect/preset disabled under legacy/force
- Offline rule: failed fetch or 404 on token-prefixed /api/* with state -> persistent banner, Cancel/Download disabled, no auto-reload; on load GET /api/jobs re-attaches
- Drift-guard test fails when assets/gui/* changes without regeneration

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui-assets]" + manual browser pass (all controls, dark + light, reload mid-job).
